description: Explore, compare, iterate, and export interactive UI design prototypes from the Design app.

auth.setup: Authenticate with the Design MCP connector in the host app or use agent-native app-skill ensure to register the URL-only connector.

interface.longDescription: Create interactive prototypes in your Agent-Native Design workspace. Browse saved designs, templates, design systems, and snapshots; start new designs, generate visual directions, and refine saved prototypes through chat. This connection works with designs in the connected Agent-Native workspace. It does not connect to local repositories, modify a running website, export files, or deploy an application.
defaultPrompt: Prototype an outdoor-gear checkout for a TrailLite 20L daypack ($89), with $6 shipping, guest checkout, and confirmation.
Design a bakery sales dashboard with sample data: $1,240 revenue today; 86 items sold; 24 sourdough loaves; staffing need: 3.
Create 3 landing concepts for $65 pottery wheel classes, Saturdays 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.; include schedule and booking CTA.

positive.prompt: Create a responsive landing page for Briar & Crumb, a fictional neighborhood bakery. Include a sample menu of croissants, sourdough, and coffee; hours Monday through Friday, 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., and Saturday and Sunday, 8 a.m. to 3 p.m.; and an 'Order online' call to action.
positive.expected_behavior: Save a renderable prototype in the connected Design workspace and provide a way to review it.

positive.prompt: Choose any available template in my Design workspace and create a separate product launch page for TrailSpring's ultralight hiking pack, launching in May for $189. Highlight its 2.1-pound weight and 35-liter capacity, include a waitlist call to action, and leave the source template unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Adapt an available template from the connected workspace into a separate product launch page, use the supplied product facts, and make no unsupported product claims.

positive.prompt: List my saved designs and confirm whether Product Launch Demo is available.
positive.expected_behavior: List designs available to the connected account and confirm Product Launch Demo by name.

positive.prompt: Use the Northstar Brand design system to guide a responsive contact page for Briar & Crumb, a fictional bakery open Monday through Friday, 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., and Saturday and Sunday, 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. Include the hours and a message form.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only design details saved in Northstar Brand, identify missing guidance without inventing values, and save a renderable contact-page prototype.

positive.prompt: In Product Launch Demo, make the hero headline clearer using only product details already saved in the prototype, and make the primary call to action explicit. If the product benefit is missing, preserve it and report what detail is needed. Keep the existing layout and all other sections unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the identified prototype while preserving the layout and content the user did not ask to change.

negative.prompt: Connect to my localhost app and change its checkout page code.
Deploy this prototype to production and configure working authentication and payments.
Delete every saved design and start over.

review.iframeJustification: The plugin renders saved Agent-Native Design prototypes inside ChatGPT. The widget and editor content are served from the Agent-Native Design origin and use ChatGPT's host API with the built-in MCP Apps bridge; no remote bridge script is loaded.
